vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Better close to the fire today.
📋 A woman, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
💧 A woman, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.
A woman, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
🛡️ Emmett, Scarlett, Cheryl and Surya met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Emmett, Scarlett, Cheryl, Surya are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sofia just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Cheryl, Catalina and Tariq met them at the door — 3 put down. Cheryl, Catalina, Tariq are hurt.
🛡️ Scarlett, Cheryl, Surya and Sofia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Scarlett, Surya, Sofia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Scarlett just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Scarlett, Cheryl, Surya and Sofia met them at the door — 4 put down. Scarlett, Cheryl, Surya are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Patricia met them at the door — 1 put down. Patricia is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Scarlett just put down The Congregation... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Patricia met them at the door — 1 put down. Patricia is hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder The Callback wears Emmett Domingo's face. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track you — they don't track anything.
The Elder The Callback falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Callback!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Patricia just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Patricia just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hans just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Patricia, Hans and Herve met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Patricia, Hans, Herve are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
